summary: Anfield Energy Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release providing a corporate update on operational and economic advancements in H1 2026. The update highlights completion of monitoring wells at Shootaring Canyon Mill, ongoing refurbishment toward 2027 production, and robust PEA economics (pre-tax IRR 106%, NPV US$606M). No specific acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change is reported. The filing is a routine operational update.
